reasoning.text: Reproducibility is bounded by the spec withholding the paper's headline contribution: the exact conflict-free (bank,offset)/crossbar map and the twiddle-reuse loop addressing are flagged source-missing, so both engineers fell back to the same generic XOR-fold and bit-reversed-ROM stand-ins (the functional NTT core, by contrast, is fully pinned and both impls converge on it). Fidelity is solid on every recoverable parameter (N, q=12289, 14-bit, 8 BU, Barrett, psi/omega/Ninv, op-count reductions all match) but weak on the system's identity: the conflict-free mapping and no-bit-reversal/natural-order structure — the very things that make this CFNTT rather than a generic radix-2/4 NTT — are unverifiable or violated in both implementations.
gaps: [operation] Paper's actual conflict-free (bank, offset) functions and per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s for arbitrary radix/#BU (the headline Sec.III contribution)
[operation] Twiddle-ROM address function f(stage,block) under the rearranged twiddle-reuse loop
[param] Naive-radix-4 add/sub baseline value (10) that anchors the 20% reduction claim
[shape] BRAM depth/primitive sizing per bank (256-vs-128 inconsistency)
[port] Host/PCIe DMA interface protocol, beat packing and coefficient ordering
[timing] Per-FSM-state cycle latencies (only the aggregate 9 cycles/lane is given)
[operation] Explicit forward/inverse butterfly convention (DIT/CT vs GS/DIF) and twiddle table layout — inferred, not stated
